scope: Every returned WorldSense frame/query model call, first/warm/failure, once. The candidate-only functional cohort is retained separately and ineligible for speed. Native correctness calls remain raw JSON, not performance samples.
decode: (generated-1)/(total-TTFT), includes host/stop/possible extraEOS/snapshot costs, not pureGPU.
memory: Single native Cantor process post-decode snapshots, not peaks/freeRAM/unique physical residency or UI/server total. Actual process PID is parsed from the cohort launchd snapshot. LegacyWS10 missing memory stays unavailable, never zero. No extra native text child/IPC gateway in60.
parent_wall: One native Skill request row only; do not sum parent wall across model phases.
initialization: First request preserved separately; old ready API lacks separate worker/model-load decomposition. No hardware-cold claim.
confirmation: Resource/screen exports are not independent confirmation or proof of isolated mechanism causality.
